**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User attended a 3-day project management workshop at the Marriott hotel last month.  
[FACT] User is looking for project management tools to help implement Agile methodology.  
[RELATIONSHIP] User has a friend named David, whom they met at the workshop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended project management tools include Jira, Trello, Asana, Microsoft Azure DevOps, Basecamp, Wrike, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Pivotal Tracker, and VersionOne.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira is developed by Atlassian and is widely used for issue tracking, project planning, and team collaboration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello is a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to organize tasks and workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana is known for its flexibility and customization options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft Azure DevOps includes project planning, tracking, and collaboration features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basecamp includes message boards, schedules, file sharing, and collaboration tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wrike offers Gantt charts, resource allocation, and customizable workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smartsheet integrates with Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Monday.com includes project management features, team collaboration, and automation tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pivotal Tracker focuses on Agile development with features like story tracking and iteration planning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] VersionOne includes project planning, tracking, reporting, and team collaboration features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira pricing model: Free for up to 10 users, Standard at $7/user/month, Premium at $14/user/month, and Enterprise with custom pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello pricing model: Free with unlimited boards, Gold at $5/user/month, Business Class at $12.50/user/month, and Enterprise with custom pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira's free plan has limitations, while Trello's free plan is generous.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira is geared towards software development teams, while Trello is more versatile and user-friendly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested Agile workflows for writing projects include sprints, user stories, Kanban boards, writing tasks, and burn-down charts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended writing tools that integrate with Trello include Scrivener, Ulysses, Google Docs, Microsoft Word, ProWritingAid, and Novelize.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ulysses integrates with Trello through a Power-Up that allows creating Trello cards directly from Ulysses.
